mechanism: Tranylcypromine is an irreversible MAOI that inhibits monoamine oxidase, and lansoprazole may have weak serotonergic properties; combined use increases risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis, particularly with foods containing tyramine.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if combination is necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor for signs of serotonin syndrome (agitation, confusion, tremor, hyperthermia) and hypertensive crisis, and provide strict dietary counseling regarding tyramine-containing foods.
